description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession's generateRequest method, specifically testing different scenarios such as success with different key systems, session already constructed, and failure cases. It uses Google Test framework for mocking and assertions.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionGenerateRequestTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing generateRequest behavior in MediaKeySession, inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: SuccessNoneNetflix
methods.description: Tests successful generateRequest for a non-Netflix key system.

methods.name: SuccessNetflix
methods.description: Tests successful generateRequest for a Netflix key system, including challenge data retrieval.

methods.name: SessionAlreadyConstructed
methods.description: Verifies that generateRequest returns OK if the session has already been constructed.

methods.name: OcdmSessionFailure
methods.description: Checks that generateRequest fails if the underlying ocdm session constructSession API fails.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Ensures generateRequest returns FAIL if an error occurs during session construction.
